messages:
deploybot: Scheduling v2 flip for "public-gateway" at 2025-06-15T18:30Z. Release r-20250615-v2. Canary steps: 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% every 9m. Ops: @marco @lisa. Reply `ack` to take.
marco: ack. I'll run in iad first on a 6-host pool. Health checks: 2xx ratio, p99 tail, and `schema_mismatch` tag.
lisa: ack. Added client pinlist check. Tenants pinned to v1: 6 (finance + gov). We'll avoid force-unpin.
josh: Note: change window shortens token TTL from 45m->30m and normalizes header `X-User-Agent` to `x-user-agent`. Docs updated with migration snippet.
analytics-bot: Dashboard card created: `v2_rollout_publicgateway`. Will tag legacy traffic as `client_version:legacy` and post T+10 snapshot.
marco: Rollback triggers proposed: sustained 5xx >1.2% for 8m OR p95 latency +200ms for 10m OR schema_mismatch >= 40 in 10m. If triggered: immediate revert to r-20250501-v1, open #incidents and alert oncall.
lisa: Dry-run scheduled at T-10m. I'll post smoke test output. If dry-run green, proceed at scheduled time.
deploybot: Dry-run executed: `/deploy r-20250615-v2 --dry-run`. Smoke tests OK (minor warning in svc-auth). Logs: https://go/logs/r-20250615-dryrun
marco: T+5 check (dry-run): 2xx 99.8%, p99 +18ms, no schema_mismatch. Proceeding to schedule.
lisa: Remember to update customer-facing changelog with header case note and TTL change. I'll move to #release-ready at +20m if no blockers.
josh: Also ping SDK teams to land the soft-fallback before T+0.1 to minimize client errors.
analytics-bot: Will post T+10 metrics after canary start.
marco: Ready on my side. Good luck team.
